pairs.question: cur non ipsa venit? cur haec certamina vitat?
pairs.derivation: Arachne, addressing the disguised Pallas, ends her retort with two interrogatives asking why the goddess does not come in person and shuns the contest. The goddess answers directly: tum dea 'venit!' ait. The question is the two contiguous interrogative sentences (cur non ipsa venit? cur haec certamina vitat?); referents (Pallas / the weaving contest) are established earlier in the same speech. Answer trimmed to the single operative word 'venit!' before the speech-tag/narration 'ait formamque removit anilem Palladaque exhibuit' (she then drops the old-woman guise and reveals herself).
